gaps.text: In-line measurement of Process temperature with temperature sensor

Combining several spectroscopy methods (data fusion) (Low-level fusion: Raman and UV-Vis ATR probes placed at the same sampling point, with data synchronised to a common time step since acquisition rates differ. Each method keeps its own calibration against its own reference assays, with block scaling so neither dominates the fused model. The fused model must beat the best single method on held-out runs, otherwise the extra instrument is dropped.)
